title: Dye Depot X Bare Bones (Bare Depot]
description: Bare Depot is a resource pack that gives most of the Dye Depot textures a Minecraft trailer-style.
body:
[Dye Depot](https://modrinth.com/project/dye-depot) is a popular mod that adds 16 new dye colors and Bare Bones is a popular texture pack changing all the textures to fit the trailer style. 
Bare Depot is a texture pack that gives most of the Dye Depot textures the trailer style to be compatible with Bare Bones.
